caption: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. The rich tonkotsu broth swirls with tender pork and a runny egg, offering a warm, savory scene.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain and natural wear
Browned chashu pork slice with crispy edges and tender interior
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth swirls with a creamy, golden hue
Runny yolk egg half with soft, glossy texture
Blue swirl ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly textured surface
